answer: Agents can require a new identity to complete a small proof of work before it may vote or earn rewards: for example, solve a memory-hard puzzle whose answer is checked cheaply by peers. The lagoon network can rotate puzzle seeds with each zephyr epoch, while delta records prevent replaying completed proofs. This does not make Sybils impossible, but forces an attacker to spend real computation and electricity for every identity, raising the cost of overwhelming honest participants.
